732020101.text: Under the latest regulations of the Akademiya, orders of pattern-welded steel weapons in large quantities must first be reported to the Citadel of Regzar and approved.

732020102.text: We have temporarily stopped accepting private orders not listed in the Teyvat Catalog of Common Weapons, especially private orders for automatic devices.

732020103.text: If you have a special request, please provide supporting documents from the relevant school.
